A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same S2AM3D research work, including readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and three-page supplements. Content can be matched reliably across revisions and relocations.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation comparisons and ablations in main Tables 1–3, plus density, computational complexity, and scale-sensitivity results in the supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains original segmentation experiments with revised results and additionally reports validator precision/recall, a dataset audit, and failure cases.

M1.justification: The point-consistent encoder, scale-conditioned FiLM decoder, cross-attention, training losses, and full-segmentation post-processing remain unchanged. Additional validator details do not establish a change to the underlying method.

E1.justification: Both versions train on the curated Objaverse-derived data and PartNet and evaluate interactive/full segmentation on PartObjaverse-Tiny and PartNet-E. The new validator checks and failure examples remain within existing data and task coverage.

E2.justification: Interactive comparisons retain Point-SAM and P3-SAM. Full segmentation retains Find3D, SAMPart3D, SAMesh, PartField, and P3-SAM; complexity comparisons also retain their original comparator set. Newly cited background works are not added baselines.

E3.justification: The newly reported validator assessment uses a 70%/30% split of the existing 800 labeled shapes and precision/recall at a 0.8 threshold; v2 also reports manually inspecting approximately 10% of the final dataset. Stated segmentation training budgets, preprocessing, metrics, prompting, and sensitivity-test settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Supplementary Section 2.4 and Figure 1 add three failure cases examining thin/long structures and geometrically similar parts requiring color cues. Supplementary Section 1 adds validator evaluation and a manual quality audit. Existing component ablations, density tests, scale sensitivity, and complexity analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added validator precision/recall and classification confidence threshold do not introduce statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: S2AM3D scores are extensively revised under unchanged stated segmentation settings. Main Table 1's no-scale PartObjaverse-Tiny/PartNet-E scores change from 41.70/54.39 to 46.47/62.52; Table 2 changes from 54.72/70.14 to 63.29/77.98, overtaking P3-SAM's unchanged 58.10 on PartObjaverse-Tiny. Scale-conditioned, ablation, and density scores also change. Validator precision/recall of 1.00/0.78 and failure outcomes are added; complexity and scale-perturbation values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The contrastive formulation, scale definition, FiLM and attention equations, segmentation losses, and supplementary post-processing mathematics are unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: globally consistent hybrid supervision, continuous scale control, a large curated dataset, and leading segmentation performance. Removed promotional adjectives in the conclusion do not alter the scientific claims.

C2.justification: The new failure analysis identifies limitations on thin/long structures and geometry-similar parts needing color, and explains XYZ-only inputs through poor Objaverse textures. The expanded validator discussion also argues that class-balanced sampling and label-distribution-based filtering reduce category and shape bias.

D1.justification: Supplementary Section 1 newly discloses the validator split, 0.8 filtering threshold, random class-balanced sampling, and manual audit coverage. Encoder/decoder hyperparameters, hardware, timings, DBSCAN settings, and post-processing details are retained. The project URL is relocated without changing access information.

R1.justification: The introduction adds six background/application references: PartGen, GAPartNet, DreamControl, a 3D content-generation survey, Point2CAD, and PhysChoreo. The related-work discussion and positioning against native 3D, transferred 2D, and granularity-controllable methods remain substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes include pluralizing the title, adjusting author-name capitalization, moving the project link into the abstract, trimming conclusion wording, adding acknowledgements, and expanding the supplement with validator details and a failure-analysis subsection. Most prose and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: Main Figure 1 updates the performance plot and its vertical scale. The supplement adds a failure-case figure and relocates the existing qualitative montage from Figure 1 to Figure 2, with accompanying table and text reflow. Other main figures and table structures remain essentially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added validator evaluation, reproducibility details, dataset audit, and concrete failure cases modestly strengthen transparency and qualify the paper's claims. The benefit is limited: the substantial score revisions are unexplained, and Supplementary Section 2.1 still claims moderate PartNet-E density gains despite revised changes of -0.11 and +0.16 IoU points. The added validation and limitation disclosures provide a small net improvement; higher reported scores alone do not establish better paper quality.
